purpose: Teach: 暴言/往来/斉唱/流星/昇る/追っかけ/エコー/ライティング

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 容疑者の、本気で、絶対、暴言、絶対、警察、絶対、記録、絶対、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The suspect made some harsh statements. We've documented everything in the official police record.
lines.style: Professional, measured tone. Even pacing. Slight formal distance in the delivery — the practiced cadence of someone used to explaining procedure.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 駅前の、本気で、絶対、往来、絶対、警察、絶対、警備、絶対、強化されているそうですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I heard the station area has had more security presence lately.
lines.style: Genuine curiosity, leaning forward slightly in tone. Conversational pace, not rushed. The careful politeness of someone asking an officer a question.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。式典の、本気で、絶対、斉唱、絶対、警備、絶対、警察、絶対、対応、絶対、いたしました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We increased our security detail for the ceremony — made sure everything ran safely.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, clear. No embellishment. The factual tone of someone reporting what was done and moving on.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 昨夜の、本気で、絶対、流星、絶対、群、絶対、市民、絶対、感動したと、聞きました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I heard the meteor shower last night really moved a lot of people.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Softer than before, almost reflective. Speaks with genuine interest, not just filling space.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。市民の、本気で、絶対、関心、絶対、昇る、絶対、社会問題、絶対、警察、絶対、注視しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're seeing more public interest in these kinds of events, and we're keeping close watch on social issues in the area.
lines.style: Steady, informative. Slight weight on the words 'keeping close watch' — the professional attentiveness of someone doing their job well.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 有名人の、本気で、絶対、追っかけ、絶対、警備、絶対、警察、絶対、ご苦労されていますか、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Does celebrity stalking create a lot of extra work for your security teams?
lines.style: Lighter question, almost sympathetic. Tone suggests genuine concern for the work involved. Conversational, not demanding.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。捜査現場の、本気で、絶対、エコー、絶対、装置、絶対、警察、絶対、活用、絶対、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We use various tools and resources at crime scenes to help with investigations — it's part of how we work effectively.
lines.style: Measured explanation, slightly technical. Deliberate pacing that suggests competence. Not defensive, just informative.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 警察の、本気で、絶対、ライティング、絶対、業務、絶対、報告書作成、絶対、大変ですよね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Police paperwork and reporting must be exhausting work.
lines.style: Gentle observation, trailing slightly at the end. Understands the toll. Warm but not patronizing — the acknowledgment of someone who notices effort.
